channel.name: QVC Beauty UK
channel.title: Laura Geller Make-up
channel.desc: Laura Geller is a renowned make-up artist, teacher and working mother and the creative force behind one of the most successful make-up studios in New York. Join us to explore her superb range.

channel.name: QVC Beauty UK
channel.title: Supersize Your Beauty
channel.desc: Buy in bulk and enjoy great value for money with this fantastic selection of supersized beauty products from a range of different brands.

channel.name: QVC Beauty UK
channel.title: M. Asam Beauty Is Our Tradition
channel.desc: Enjoy younger looking skin with M.Asam, an effective skincare range that blends innovative technique and ingredients including grape oil, to target fine lines and wrinkles.

channel.name: QVC Beauty UK
channel.title: Beauty Tools & Accessories
channel.desc: The beauty tools you use are as important as your products, so enjoy professional-standard implements and accessories, from lash curlers to make-up bags and tweezers to brushes.

channel.name: QVC Beauty UK
channel.title: Scandinavian BioLabs
channel.desc: Discover Scandinavian BioLabs - innovative haircare inspired by nature. Explore formulas designed to help hair look fuller and healthier.

channel.name: QVC Beauty UK
channel.title: Beauty Steals and Deals
channel.desc: Love beauty? Tune in to see the latest deals and bag a beauty bargain. We've got an exciting array of popular and iconic brands plus cult products you're sure to adore.

channel.name: QVC Beauty UK
channel.title: Doll10 Beauty
channel.desc: the pioneer in age reversal beauty and a combination of breakthrough technologies, age transforming complexes and real life make-up techniques.

channel.name: QVC Beauty UK
channel.title: Neom Wellbeing London
channel.desc: In this show, explore an array of products from Neom Wellbeing, combining fabulous fragrances with naturally-sourced ingredients to offer you luxury aromatherapy products for the body, bath and home.

channel.name: QVC Beauty UK
channel.title: Tarte Cosmetics
channel.desc: This show features high performance natural products from Tarte Cosmetics, including everything from Amazonian clay to maracuja oil. Find a wide variety of glamorous eco-chic products you'll love.

channel.name: QVC Beauty UK
channel.title: bareMinerals
channel.desc: The perfect blend of cosmetics and skincare, the bareMinerals range is ideal for women who are concerned about the additives, preservatives and fragrances routinely found in make-up.

channel.name: QVC Beauty UK
channel.title: Perricone MD Skincare
channel.desc: Today's show focuses on NV Perricone skincare, specially formulated to tackle the signs of ageing.
